NOTE: exact NUMERIC equality of two separate repair_target calls on the SAME organ is NOT expected and NOT the claim -- a pre-existing, xedge-unrelated background-noise carryover (_hard_reset restores v/u but not any background noise generator) makes back-to-back reads on one organ non-bit-reproducible even before this fix; that is why 'byte-identical' here is scoped to the resolved wm_focus VALUE and the absence of xedge influence, not full numeric output equality.
